author: olzy
quote:
This does not feel like the past GTAs.
Story, given there is no online mode yet it is mainly a story and open world game. The story is dull and starts incredibly slowly. Rockstar advised customers the romance is not mandatory. Sure you can skip out some of the tasks but some romance missions are mandatory to complete to progress the story. The story forces you to chase after a uninspiring, unfunny, unrelatable, girlboss. It is written certainly by sheltered well off people with no actual real life experience or adversaries. Ai could have done a better job at writing.
Game world looks pretty enough this team definitely is carrying rockstar, the writing team needs firing. However even though this is one of the redeeming qualities of the game the 30fps cap and it dropping below 30 seriously ruins immersion, many far away objects are blurry and out of focus. Comparing this to its closest competitor cyberpunk I can play on my PC Gta6 is no where near the level of detail and graphics offered. 
No humour, this game is missing the sharp witty humour from previous titles. 
Car theft issues, being blocked from committing GTA in GTA is infuriating.
No physical media, no disc or physical media also locked to console only which can't exactly play this game the best, serious mistakes. Ultimate edition rewards some are only available for first chapter lol.
Doubtful I will be supporting rockstar going forward.
Seriously missed the mark with this game, western AAA studios are in serious decline. This will affect the whole gaming industry as I certainly will not be buying anything quickly going forward now I feel that I was scammed to buy a ps5 only to get delivered this. Despite this journalist giving it a 100? How can a game get 100 with so many glaring issues. Very disappointed
